quarterly_data.signal: Live with autonomous vehicles in seven cities, on track to be live in 15 cities by year-end, with launches coming from Nuro-Lucid in the Bay Area, Zoox in Vegas, Wayve in London and Tokyo, and Baidu in London; launching on Uber's built-in demand drives utilization often in the mid to high 20s to low 30s trips per vehicle per day.
quarterly_data.figure: live in seven cities; 15 cities by year-end; utilization mid to high 20s, low 30s trips per vehicle per day

quarterly_data.signal: $10 billion of AV investments over a multi-year period: equity stakes in AV software partners plus balance-sheet support for fleet ops, real estate and OEM off-take commitments; about 120,000 vehicle commitments to deliver over the next few years; every dollar invested has catalyzed an additional $2.50 of external fundraising for AV partners.
quarterly_data.figure: $10 billion multi-year AV investment; 120,000 vehicle commitments; additional $2.50 raised per dollar invested

quarterly_data.signal: AVs are doing hundreds of thousands of trips per week versus roughly 300 million Uber trips per week - less than 0.5% of overall trip volume; trip growth in San Francisco, L.A. and Phoenix accelerated in Q2 versus Q1 and Uber's category position in mature AV markets is higher than a year ago.
quarterly_data.figure: hundreds of thousands of AV trips per week; less than 0.5% of ~300 million total weekly trips

quarterly_data.signal: Waymo remains a very important partner, with Uber continuing to operate in Austin and Atlanta and expecting to continue next year; the Nuro-Lucid robotaxi program is a big order with guaranteed volume on a car in the $70,000-$80,000 range; Rivian's full-stack robotaxi with a very affordable bill of materials is expected in perhaps San Francisco and Miami in 2028.
quarterly_data.figure: Lucid robotaxi in the $70,000-$80,000 range; Rivian expected 2028

quarterly_data.signal: AV Labs is building out hundreds of cars with robotaxi-grade sensors to collect one high-fidelity, rideshare-specific data set provided to all AV partners for L4 model training, as end-to-end models replace the heuristics approach across the AV industry.

Gross bookings grew 22% year-over-year to more than $58 billion, the fourth consecutive quarter above 20% growth; non-GAAP EPS grew 35% year-over-year; trailing 12-month free cash flow exceeded $10 billion for the first time.
quarterly_data.figure: gross bookings +22% YoY to more than $58 billion; non-GAAP EPS +35%; trailing 12-month FCF exceeded $10 billion

connects_to.relationship: NVIDIA autonomous-vehicle platform powers robotaxi fleet deployed on Uber's network

contracts.signal: Uber expects NVIDIA-powered robotaxis to be in L.A. and San Francisco in 2027, and then 28 different cities globally by 2028.
contracts.units: L.A. and San Francisco in 2027; 28 different cities globally by 2028
